# has genre

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGenre`](gmeow-hasGenre.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGenre>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

Relates a creative work to a genre that characterises it. Non-functional and always contestable: competing genre claims coexist as standpoint-indexed statements ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
